title: Registration Assistant
description:
Mission of the Role:

Due to growth & expansion of business in Brazil, CAC is looking to hire a seasoned professional who will be responsible for support and accelerate product registration and compliance activities in the Brazilian market , reporting to Registration manager in Brazil. The key objectives for this role are:

  • Managing the submission, follow-up, and maintenance of product registrations in Brazil
  • ensures compliance with national regulatory requirements (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) and supports the company's product launch plans in alignment with global and regional regulatory strategies.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and execute registration strategies for Brazil in line with business priorities and product portfolio
  • Prepare, compile, and submit registration dossiers for technical and formulated products in compliance with local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external consultants, laboratories, manufacturers, and internal technical teams to ensure high-quality and complete submissions.
  • Communicate with regulatory authorities (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) through local partners or directly when required.
  • Monitor progress of submissions, follow up on authority requests, and manage timelines to ensure efficient approval.
  • Track and analyze updates in Brazilian and LATAM regulatory frameworks, assessing potential business impacts and advising management accordingly.
  • Maintain accurate registration data and documentation archives to ensure full traceability and compliance.
  • Provide regulatory support to commercial, marketing, and R&D teams regarding registration timelines, status, and compliance requirements.
  • Support post-registration activities, such as renewals, label updates, and re-registration processes.
  • Collaborate with global regulatory teams to align strategies and share best practices.

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Graduate in Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or related fields.
  • 4 years of working experience in regulatory affairs or product registration within the agrochemical / crop protection industry.
  • In-depth understanding of Brazil's registration procedures and authorities: MAPA/IBMA/ANVISA and state authorities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple registration projects with strict timelines
  • Strong coordination and communication skills with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in English (written & spoken) and Portuguese (mandatory for Brazil-based communication).
  • Detail-oriented and capable of interpreting technical and scientific data.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience in a multinational agrochemical company or regulatory consulting firm

Soft skill:

  • Demonstrates a proactive, self-driven approach with a high sense of accountability.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment

title: L2 - Security Engineer (EDR Solutions)
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world's largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)

Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.

Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.

Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.

Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator

At HCLTech, we don't just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.

Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

Ready to #FindYourSpark and be part of a team that's #SuperchargingProgress?

Apply now or reach out to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

title: Consultor de Vendas - Off Trade São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados, que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia, gerir sua carteira de clientes e a criatividade para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões criativas e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades (do restaurante, do hotel) e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição do Cargo

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas Off-Trade é uma peça-chave na estratégia da Zahil em São Paulo. Ele(a) é responsável por construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais mercados e lojas da cidade.

A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, é preciso agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado de São Paulo. Flexibilidade, capacidade de improvisação e vontade de aprender constantemente. O objetivo é ser um parceiro estratégico para o cliente garantindo visibilidade e o crescimento mútuo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes Off-Trade em São Paulo, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Analisar o portfólio dos clientes e apresentar os rótulos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença, considerando "pricing" e perfil do estabelecimento.
  • Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos, ações de visibilidade e condições comerciais.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes (volume, mix de produtos) e propor ações para atingir as metas.
  • Transmitir à gerência as dificuldades, demandas do mercado (concorrência, preços) e oportunidades que ultrapassem sua autonomia.
  • Apoiar no uso dos sistemas internos de CRM (para gestão do funil) e de faturamento (para colocação de pedidos).

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos técnico ou de extensão (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês ou espanhol
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de três anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal Off-Trade de bebidas (especialmente vinhos).
  • Networking: Um relacionamento ativo e uma carteira pré-existente será um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e perfil "hunter" (caçador).

Remuneração:

  • Regime CLT: R$ 3.000,00 (três mil reais) de salário fixo + comissão mensal
  • Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale Mobilidade e Plano médico Unimed

title: Especialista FP&A "#982821"
description:
Quem Somos

"A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de "staffing augmentation" dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente do segmento de Indústria.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

– Desenvolvimento do Orçamento: Colaborar na preparação de orçamentos anuais, trimestrais e/ou mensais em conjunto com a equipe financeira e outros departamentos relevantes. Isso inclui a identificação de metas financeiras, a previsão de receitas e despesas e a alocação de recursos.

– Análise de Desempenho Financeiro: Monitorar e analisar o desempenho financeiro real em relação ao orçamento planejado, identificando variações e suas causas. Fornecer relatórios e recomendações para melhorar o desempenho. Conciliar contas de receita e custo e participar ativamente das análises de vendas e da cadeia de suprimentos.

– Revisão e atualização do orçamento: Realize revisões periódicas dos orçamentos conforme novas informações e cenários em mudança surgem. Faça ajustes e atualizações conforme necessário.

– Relatórios: Preparar relatórios financeiros e apresentações para a alta administração e partes interessadas internas, comunicando os resultados orçamentários e propondo ações corretivas quando necessário.

– Gestão de Despesas: Apoiar a gestão de despesas da empresa, garantindo que os custos permaneçam dentro dos limites orçamentários e identificando oportunidades de otimização de custos. Participar dos fluxos de trabalho de aprovação de despesas e da configuração de sistemas internos.

– Apoio a Projetos Especiais: Participe de projetos especiais relacionados a finanças, como análises de viabilidade, investimentos e planejamento estratégico.

– Conformidade e Auditoria: Garantir que todas as transações financeiras estejam em conformidade com os regulamentos e as políticas internas da empresa. Fornecer suporte para auditorias internas e externas.

O que você precisa ter:

– Sólida experiência em FP&A (experiência anterior em funções de análise financeira ou orçamentária);

– Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração de Empresas ou área correlata.

– Inglês Avançado ;

– Habilidades analíticas: Forte capacidade analítica com capacidade de interpretar dados e relatórios financeiros.

– Comunicação e trabalho em equipe: Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em um ambiente de equipe.

– Atenção aos detalhes: Fortes habilidades organizacionais e atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.

– Ferramentas de escritório: Proficiência no Microsoft Office, especialmente habilidades avançadas no Excel.

– Conhecimento de sistemas: experiência com Oracle e Power BI é um diferencial

Inglês avançado obrigatório, irá falar com chineses diariamente, precisa saber falar termos técnicos.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Atuação presencial em Pouso Alegre (avaliam profissionais que queiram se mudar para a região).

Modelo de Contrato:

CLT + benefícios diretamente pelo cliente.

title: Domain Architect Operations Technology
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid, in the city of São Paulo.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial IoT, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.

Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and govern OT architectures, ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, IoT sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
  • Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
  • Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
  • Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
  • Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
  • Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
  • Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, IoT sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
  • Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
  • Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
  • Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.
  • Experience with governance, regulatory compliance, sustainability and ESG standards in the mining and process industry.
  • Fluent English for global communication and advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada work.

Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, negotiation skills and influence in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strategic vision to connect OT technological innovation to business, safety and sustainability.
  • Clear and effective communication to diverse stakeholders and technical and executive teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, critical thinking and focus on sustainable and safe results.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Technical certifications in OT (ISA/IEC 62443, Certified Automation Professional, Cybersecurity Certifications).
  • Experience with industrial digital platforms, analytics, AI/ML applied to operation.
  • Experience in operations or in large-scale mining.

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer's security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer's key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer's cybersecurity partner of choice.
Your Impact
Role
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
  • Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers.
  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.
  • Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
  • Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.
  • Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences
  • Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
  • Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy.
  • Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
  • Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space
  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 6+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering
  • Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.
  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred
  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred
  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
Additional Information
The Team
Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.
You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers' cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: User Acquisition Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Overview

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven professional to lead new user engagement initiatives through targeted segmentation and optimized incentive strategies. This role plays a key part in driving user growth and conversion across digital platforms, with a strong focus on performance analysis, experimentation, and cross-functional execution.

Job Responsabilities

Strategy and Planning

  • Develop annual and quarterly goals and operational plans for new user conversion.
  • Design differentiated conversion strategies based on user registration source, region, and timing.
  • Create incentive schemes such as first-order discounts, limited-time subsidies, and combo packages, and ensure their effective implementation.

Campaign Planning and Execution

  • Plan exclusive campaigns for new users, such as first-order discounts, first-week offers, and welcome bonuses.
  • Incorporate holiday promotions into marketing campaigns.
  • Coordinate with design, product, marketing, and merchant operations teams to ensure timely campaign launches and optimized user experience.

Data Analysis and Optimization

  • Monitor core metrics related to new user conversion (registration-to-first-order rate, first-order cost, early retention, etc.).
  • Conduct post-campaign reviews, analyze user behavior paths, and identify conversion bottlenecks.
  • Adjust strategies quickly based on data insights and continuously optimize performance.

User Insights and Segmentation

  • Analyze new users' characteristics based on source, preferences, and purchasing power.
  • Develop refined segmentation-based operational plans to improve conversion efficiency across different user segments.
  • Continuously iterate segmentation logic based on market competition and user feedback.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; preferred majors include engineering, business, or related fields.
  • Fluent in English, with proven ability to communicate effectively across international teams.
  • Experience in traffic operations, content distribution, growth product management, or similar roles within internet platforms.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, or local life services platforms is preferred; experience with local services platforms is a strong plus.
  • Overseas experience in internet product roles is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with in-platform resource management logic and a systematic understanding of user growth funnels.
  • Proficient in data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, BI platforms), with strong data sensitivity and analytical thinking.
  • Hands-on experience with traffic distribution strategies, content efficiency evaluation, and A/B testing design.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and project management skills; results-oriented with excellent execution capability.

COFCO International is an agribusiness platform of COFCO Corporation, one of China's largest agricultural and food companies, with global operations.

About the position:

Responsible for COFCO's transactional processes in the areas of Accounting, Tax Calculation, Tax Receipts, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Service Contracts, Freight, and Consumer Account Management, ensuring process efficiency through compliance with the area's KPIs and SLAs.

Ensure compliance with the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;

Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;

Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;

Seek to unify and standardize transaction processes for the SSC.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;

More than 7 years of experience in SSC is required;

Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;

Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;

Fluency in English;

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint);

Experience with the SAP system;

Experience with SLAs and KPIs;

Strong project and process management skills;

Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;

Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.

Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Analista Governança/Gerenciamento de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades:

●Implementação e Melhoria Contínua: Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar processos, políticas e padrões de governança de dados, assegurando sua aplicação em projetos e na operação diária.

●Framework DAMA-DMBOK: Aplicar as melhores práticas e áreas de conhecimento do DAMA-DMBOK para estruturar a gestão de dados corporativos de forma eficaz.

●Conformidade e LGPD: Garantir a conformidade dos processos de tratamento de dados com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) e outras regulamentações aplicáveis, atuando na identificação e mitigação de riscos.

●Qualidade de Dados (Data Quality): Definir, monitorar e gerenciar métricas e regras de qualidade de dados, liderando iniciativas para correção e prevenção de inconsistências.

●Modelagem de Dados: Colaborar na criação e manutenção de modelos de dados (relacional e multidimensional), garantindo que o design atenda aos padrões de governança.

●Ferramentas de Governança: Gerenciar e operar soluções de catálogo de dados, integração e linhagem (Data Lineage) para proporcionar transparência e rastreabilidade.

●Gestão de Metadados: Estruturar e gerenciar o repositório de metadados técnicos e de negócio.

●Suporte a Projetos: Atuar como ponto focal de Governança de Dados em projetos de TI, orientando as equipes sobre os requisitos e padrões a serem seguidos.

Competências Técnicas:

●Domínio Estratégico do DAMA-DMBOK: Capacidade de definir a estratégia de governança de uma organização com base no framework, atuando como referência (SME).

●Arquitetura de Dados: Capacidade de liderar a definição da arquitetura de dados sob a ótica da governança, influenciando o design de soluções transacionais e analíticas.

●LGPD: Atuação como referência (SME) em projetos de adequação à LGPD, definindo políticas e processos complexos.

●Estratégia de Ferramentas: Experiência em definir a estratégia, arquitetura e liderar a implementação de plataformas de governança de dados (Catálogo, Qualidade, Linhagem).

●Cloud: Experiência prática com serviços de dados e governança nas principais nuvens (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud).

●Metodologias: Conhecimento prático em DevSecOps aplicado a pipelines de dados e metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Certificações (Desejável):

●Certificação: Mínimo de uma certificação relevante para a área, como:

○DAMA CDMP (nível Associate ou Practitioner)

○Certificações de ferramentas específicas (ex: Informatica, Collibra) no nível fundamental

Diferenciais:

●Conhecimento avançado ou experiência como administrador na ferramenta INFORMATICA, especialmente nos módulos CDGC (Cloud Data Governance and Catalog).

●Experiência com soluções analíticas e plataformas de Big Data.

●Experiência prévia em setores com alta regulamentação de dados (financeiro, saúde, etc.).

●Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Formação: Superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-Graduação/MBA: Pelo menos uma Pós-Graduação, MBA ou certificação de nível avançado/expert relacionada à Gestão, Arquitetura ou Governança de Dados.

Idiomas: Inglês avançado ou fluente para colaboração com equipes globais.

description:

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Modelo de trabalho:

Hibrído, na região de Florianópolis - SC.

Como é ser uma pessoa Site Reliability Engineer:

Você irá trabalhar em um time multifuncional, criando, mantendo e evoluindo soluções de infraestrutura, que suportem o crescimento dos serviços da tribo. Contribuir na evolução da cultura de excelência operacional em engenharia, usando as melhores práticas de SRE e DevOps do mercado, buscando aprimorar automação de infraestrutura, observabilidade, gestão de custos e gestão de incidentes

Trabalhamos em um modelo ágil com discovery e delivery conectados, proporcionando dinamismo nas atividades e uma busca constante por resultados através de experimentos e ciclos curtos de validações. Portanto, buscamos alguém que goste e tenha facilidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, orientado a métricas e com excelentes práticas de SRE.

O que esperamos de você:

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development: Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration: Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership: Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation: Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery: Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Talent Development Partner
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world's top innovators, Turing's leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.

Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.

Values

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Gerente de Field Marketing Sr
description:
Na ADP, somos motivados pelo seu sucesso. Fazemos com que seus talentos e perspectivas únicos se transformem em um todo. Suas ideias para fazer de modo diferente e melhor são bem-vindas. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso motiva você, você tem a cara da ADP.

A ADP é uma empresa global e uma das líderes de mercado em soluções de RH. Recentemente, ganhou o prêmio de uma das Melhores Empresas para se Trabalhar da Great Place to Work.

RESUMO DO CARGO

O Gerente de Field Marketing de Campo Sr é responsável por apoiar o crescimento da receita de vendas em todo a América Latina por meio de um plano de marketing equilibrado, O foco principal será a geração de leads, apoiar ativações de marketing locais e fornecer suporte à gestão de eventos em tempo real (eventos como feiras, almoços e aprendizados, webinars, etc.).

Atuará como consultor de marketing e suporte para os Gerentes e Vice-Presidentes de Vendas da América Latina, garantindo que o plano de marketing apoie os objetivos de negócios do país, bem como os principais impulsionadores de negócios da ESI.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Avaliação de Mercado (cenário competitivo, competência diferenciada, problemas de mercado)
  • Entender o mercado-alvo – por persona, por segmento, por geografia.
  • Identificar as principais estratégias dos concorrentes e garantir que a ADP tenha uma posição atraente e diferenciada no mercado.
  • Criar um plano de marketing alinhado à estratégia central da ESI, bem como às necessidades locais do país.
  • Impulsionar uma campanha de marketing integrada que gere crescimento – alavancando as ferramentas e recursos da ESI e da Global e/ou criando algo do zero que fale diretamente com o mercado-alvo, conforme necessário.
  • Estabelecer parcerias com Vendas, Capacitação e Gestão de País para criar um senso compartilhado de propriedade, um calendário conjunto de atividades e métricas pelas quais medimos o sucesso.
  • Comunicar e educar a equipe de vendas sobre atividades de marketing novas e planejadas, incluindo programas globais, regionais e locais.
  • Desempenhar um papel ativo na comunicação de marketing.
  • Estabelecer parceria com o marketing de produtos regional para desenvolver ferramentas, programas prontos, treinamento e conteúdo para destacar com sucesso os produtos locais no mix de marketing.
  • Estabelecer parceria com a equipe de relações públicas da ESI e com o fornecedor local de RP para apoiar histórias relevantes, cobertura e construção de marca no mercado local.
  • Gerenciar o orçamento alocado para iniciativas de crescimento e direcionar a melhor alocação para o orçamento digital em conjunto e em acordo com o Gerente de Marketing Digital para a América Latina.
  • Prever, mensurar, analisar e relatar o impacto e o ROI dos programas.
  • Avaliar, selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores locais relacionados a eventos físicos/virtuais que contribuam para programas de criação de demanda local.
  • Estabelecer parceria com as equipes de operações de marketing da ADP e os fornecedores da ESI para apoiar os resultados em marketing digital, web (SEM) e eDM, contribuindo com conteúdo e expertise para aprimorar o ROI.
  • Desenvolver e implementar (com vendas) estratégias de contas-alvo para apoiar a venda baseada em contas.
  • Conteúdo de marketing: localize ativos de marketing globais adicionando localização apropriada, desenvolva estudo de caso para clientes de referência, materiais de vendas, ferramentas de vendas.

REQUISITOS

  • Sólida bagagem em Field Marketing
  • Excelente fluência em inglês para negócios.
  • Domínio da língua espanhola desejável, mas não essencial.
  • Vasta experiência em marketing B2B, com histórico comprovado de conquistas significativas de novos negócios. (Experiência em software de RH e folha de pagamento desejável, mas não essencial.)
  • Liderança de Pessoas: Foca em Comunicação Impactante, Construção de Talentos e Construção de Relacionamentos para desenvolver relacionamentos internos e externos necessários para o sucesso

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

"Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo no 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador."

title: Performance Test Engineer
description:
• Project Description:

    • The developed product is a leading software system in the Energy domain, covering all aspects of Oil & Gas production—from geological exploration to the optimization of ongoing operations. Our technology solution enables geologists and geophysicists to efficiently research, visualize, and interpret large volumes of geological data.

    You'll be joining a senior, supportive, and friendly team, committed to delivering high-quality solutions in the industry.

    • Responsibilities:

    • Develop, execute, and maintain performance test plans, scripts, and scenarios for drilling applications.

    • Analyze system behavior under stress, load, and endurance conditions to identify performance bottlenecks and work with development teams for resolution.

    • Use tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, or custom scripts to simulate operational environments typical in drilling operations.

    • Collaborate with software architects, developers, and DevOps to optimize throughput, latency, and resource utilization.

    • Monitor key performance indicators (CPU, memory, I/O, network) during test executions using tools like New Relic and correlate results with backend logs and telemetry data.

    • Create performance benchmark baselines and contribute to SLAs definition for system responsiveness and throughput.

    • Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating performance testing into automated workflows (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

    • Participate in code and architecture reviews to assess and improve system scalability and resiliency.

    • Generate detailed test reports and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

    • Mandatory Skills Description:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

    • 3+ years of experience in performance engineering or testing in enterprise or industrial software.

    • Strong Java and/or C# Core understanding with the ability to debug issues, analyse stacktraces, and perform root cause analysis

    • Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for test automation.

    • Experience with monitoring tools like New Relic, Dynatrace.

    • Solid understanding of network latency, threading/concurrency, memory profiling, and database performance (SQL/NoSQL).

    • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to interpret performance metrics into actionable insights

    • Software development background, ability to modify code

    • Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

    • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or private data centers supporting oilfield operations.

    • Familiarity with oil and gas drilling workflows, real-time data protocols.

    • ISTQB or other performance testing certifications.

    English: B2 Upper Intermediate

  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de manutenção e custos;
  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de processos e melhoria contínua (SDCA, PDCA, etc.)

Qual localidade?

Tanabi - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Creative Content & Concept Specialist with a background in film, video production, or screenplay writing to develop short-form video concepts and narrative structures. This role requires strong storytelling ability, visual thinking, and the skill to translate creative ideas into clear, structured briefs suitable for production and content development workflows.

Day-to-day responsibilities:

Develop short-form video concepts, creative storylines, and scene breakdowns across genres such as drama, comedy, lifestyle, and commercial content.

  • Write clear, production-ready descriptions of scenes, including character actions, camera framing, and sound or environmental cues.
  • Create structured documentation of concepts, ensuring clarity, visual coherence, and emotional consistency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative, production, and quality teams to refine ideas and maintain alignment with content guidelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, continuity, and realism in narrative flow and shot composition.

Manage multiple creative assignments with quick turnarounds while maintaining quality and originality.

Requirements:

Strong background in film, video production, or content creation — understanding of visual storytelling, camera work, and editing principles.

  • Excellent command of English with the ability to write visually descriptive and emotionally engaging content.
  • Knowledge of screenplay formatting and shot structuring (e.g., INT./EXT., scene timing, transitions).
  • Ability to visualize scenes and translate abstract ideas into practical, shootable concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, creative judgment, and consistency in tone and pacing.
  • Basic familiarity with structured writing formats (Markdown, JSON, TSV, or similar) is a plus.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Film Studies, Mass Communication, English, Media Production, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in creative writing, video production, content development, or screenplay writing.
  • Prior work in short films, advertising content, or storytelling-based projects is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working under tight timelines with collaborative, cross-functional teams.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for storytelling and cinematic content creation.
  • Strong visual and auditory imagination with attention to human detail.
  • Ability to self-direct, manage multiple creative briefs, and maintain high quality under deadlines.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.

Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.

Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android.
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device.
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection.
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required.
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards.
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About the role:

As an Sales Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America's product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a target-driven environment and enjoys developing long-term relationships with clients.

In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Sales Growth: As a hunter in the sales field, develop and nurture relationships with existing clients while identifying and securing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consultative Selling: Engage with key decision-makers in small to midsize organizations to present and position BSI products and services, helping them meet ISO standards.
  • Pipeline Development: Identify and qualify new business leads, building a continuous sales pipeline to support long-term success.
  • Client Relationship Management: Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.
  • Market Trend Identification: Stay ahead of industry trends, strategizing to capture new revenue generation opportunities.
  • Accurate Reporting: Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.
  • Travel for Success: Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Sales Experience: At least four years of experience in sales.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Strong ability to negotiate, influence, and build relationships with both internal teams and external clients.
  • Collaboration Mindset: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience with CRM tools like SAP and Salesforce is an advantage.
  • Valid Driver's License: Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we're truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

  • If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Supervisor Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Supervisionar a área de Segurança do Trabalho, realizando gestão das equipes, assessorando as áreas, garantindo o cumprimento da legislação pertinente, com intuito de assegurar condições que eliminem ou reduzam ao mínimo os riscos de ocorrência de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, bem como promover qualidade de vida no trabalho.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, com especialização em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Experiência em supervisão de equipes de segurança e gestão de programas como PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT, PGR e GRO;
  • Conhecimento atualizado das NRs (Normas Regulamentadoras);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de controle, auditoria e indicadores de segurança;
  • Habilidade para ministrar treinamentos e conduzir investigações de acidentes;
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos entre unidades - necessário CNH "B";

Desejável:

  • Registro ativo no CREA;
  • Experiência em ambiente industrial e agroindustrial;

Atividades:

  • Supervisionar, orientar e conduzir as atividades relacionadas à Segurança do Trabalho, com o objetivo de garantir a preservação da vida e integridade das pessoas, oferecendo condições ideais de trabalho, propondo ações que previnem incidentes e acidentes, possibilitando também redução de paradas nos processos operacionais e redução dos custos indiretos da Cooperativa.
  • Garantir a implementação de medidas preventivas e corretivas necessárias à eliminação dos riscos de acidentes e incidentes de Segurança e Saúde do Trabalho abrangendo a análise e investigação por meio de relatórios específicos e planos de ações.
  • Supervisionar a elaboração e emissão de PGR/PGRTR, PCMSO e LTCAT, garantindo a atualização, cumprimento dos cronogramas e demais laudos das áreas.
  • Monitorar e acompanhar as ações referentes ao programa de gestão de terceiros.
  • Assegurar a implementação de Procedimentos, Instruções, Normas e Políticas em Segurança do Trabalho e o cumprimento das obrigações legais vigentes.
  • Acompanhar as auditorias, perícias técnicas e atendimento à representantes de órgãos oficiais.
  • Atuar como assistente técnico pericial em causas trabalhistas e previdenciárias.
  • Garantir a implementação de projetos e de programas de Segurança do Trabalho, contribuindo para o atendimento à requisitos legais (NRs) e normas da Cooperativa.
  • Buscar e praticar níveis de excelência na área de Segurança do Trabalho das unidades.
  • Assegurar o bom andamento dos grupos de trabalhos e comitês de segurança da Cooperativa, acompanhando a implementação de planos de ações, realizando análise crítica dos resultados e apresentando a nível estratégico.

title: Analista de Recebíveis
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Reuniões mensais com jurídico para tomada de decisão nas ações judiciais relacionadas a contrato de locação;

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C), Sao Paulo, Brazil
description:

Luxoft is a global leader in Murex services. As a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner, we deliver end-to-end implementations, integrations, upgrades, and migrations across all major asset classes. With 200+ successful Murex projects in investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance, we are a trusted partner for the world's top financial institutions.

We are looking for Murex Integration Specialists to join our team and help clients achieve seamless, end-to-end system integration.

What you'll do:

  • Implement, develop, and support MX.3 proprietary modules such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, RTBS/MDCS, and C2.0 Product Interfaces.
  • Build and enhance integration points, convert existing ones with version upgrades, and develop MxML workflows.
  • Work with SQL, UNIX, MSL, XML/XSLT, and scripting languages for automation and workflow optimization.
  • Support clients with end-of-day processes, trade life cycle management, and packaged interfaces like MarkitWire, DTCC, IceLink, FXAll, and more.
  • Contribute to design, build, test, and documentation, collaborating with technical teams and clients on-site or remotely.
  • Participate in testing cycles (SIT/UAT) and provide professional support to resolve integration issues.

Must-have skills:

  • 4+ years of Murex Datamart and workflow experience.
  • Hands-on experience with MxML Exchange development and Murex integration modules.
  • Strong SQL/RDBMS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with UNIX/Linux, scripting (Shell, Python, etc.), and Murex proprietary languages (MSL, XMLF).
  • Experience with integration frameworks, packaged interfaces, and APIs.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English (C2).

Nice-to-have:

  • Knowledge of trade life cycle, market data management, or test management.
  • Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD tools, Jenkins, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Why Luxoft?

  • Work with a global Murex leader on challenging and high-impact projects.
  • Gain exposure to end-to-end capital markets solutions.
  • Continuous learning and career growth in a collaborative environment.

Location: São Paulo, Brazil ( Hybrid model 3x a week in the office)

  • Level: Experienced / Regular

title: Analista Supply Chain
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.

Objetivo do Cargo:

O(a) Analista de Supply III será responsável por liderar iniciativas em toda a cadeia de Procure-to-Pay dentro do setor de Oil & Gas, garantindo processos de aquisição eficientes, compliance regulatório e geração de valor por meio da negociação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e identificação de oportunidades de savings. Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.

Responsabilidades

Procura & Negociação:

  • Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.

Análise & Gestão de Performance:

  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.
  • Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.

Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.

Liderança & Desenvolvimento:

  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.

Requisitos

Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.
  • Forte conhecimento em negociação, gestão de contratos e análise financeira.
  • Domínio de ERP (preferencialmente JDE ou Oracle) e ferramentas analíticas (Excel avançado, Power BI).
  • Inglês fluente.

Desejáveis:

  • Certificações (CPSM, CSCP, CFA ou similares).
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.

Competências & Habilidades:

  • Visão estratégica aliada à execução tática.
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.
  • Organização, gestão de múltiplas prioridades e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

Diferenciais

  • Comunicação empática em ambiente feminino: respeito e segurança em primeiro lugar. Sinais: linguagem acolhedora, escuta ativa, confidencialidade.

title: On-Site IT Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.
